commands.review_summary:
The branch adds a fresh-token fast path, a 1s timeout around parent-fork token counting, and regression tests for fresh, timed-out, and oversized parent-fork decisions.

PR surface: Source +21, Tests +62. Total +83 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: make parent-token resolution exceed the PR timeout and resolveParentForkDecision returns fork, after which current session-create, reply, and subagent fork paths can still call forkSessionFromParentTranscript. I did not run a live slow-filesystem reproduction in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The PR needs a contributor semantic correction plus real caller-path proof; the external proof gate is not something an automated repair can supply for the contributor.
